title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, on July 5, investigated by BFRO.
Since 1994, New England has had 126 verified Bigfoot sightings, with BFRO conducting site visits to verify claims.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett states there's no scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence despite fossil evidence of large extinct apes.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of advice columnist Ann Landers, passed away at 86, leaving a legacy in advice columns.
Howard wrote the 'Dear Prudence' column for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for The Boston Globe, known for tough love advice.
Meredith Goldstein recalls Howard's impact on her, emphasizing finding joy after loss and avoiding prolonged grief.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
Boston Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, scoring 15 hits against the Athletics.
Newcomer Raymond Burgos pitched three hitless innings in his debut for the Red Sox.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are engaging in competitive battles during Patriots training camp.
Gonzalez is intentionally trash-talking Brown to prepare him for facing other top corners this season.
New England Patriots plan to offer Gonzalez a new contract despite his ongoing participation in camp.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, Red Sox's new catcher, starts rehab assignment Saturday with Triple-A Worcester for left wrist inflammation recovery.
Rutschman, acquired from Orioles, was on 10-day IL since July 20, last played on July 18.
The switch-hitting catcher is expected to catch five innings and have two to three at-bats in his rehab start.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' is now streaming on Paramount+, featuring a grown Aang and Dave Bautista as a warrior.
'You, Me & Tuscany' starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page is available for streaming on Peacock.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4, with Jason Sudeikis returning, is now streaming on Apple TV, focusing on a new women's soccer team.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet is unlikely to return to the Red Sox starting rotation in 2026 due to prolonged injury rehabilitation.
Interim manager Chad Tracy considers using Crochet in a bullpen role if he returns, highlighting prior pitching experience in relief.
Crochet, recovering from shoulder and lat injuries, began short-distance throwing, marking progress since his last game in April.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester by Boston Animal Care and Control.
The snake was left in a cage at a community garden; it has been taken to a facility in Roslindale.
Anyone with information about the snake is asked to contact Boston Animal Care and Control at 617-635-1800.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 win over Drake Maye's Team White in a Patriots scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas had a standout performance for Team Blue, catching six passes including two touchdowns.
Injury updates: Will Campbell expected back after weekend, Carlton Davis out until next week, and Brenden Schooler's return is uncertain.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich was voted the best town on Cape Cod by over 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
Harwich features nearly 11 miles of shoreline, seven villages, and more than 20 beaches along Nantucket Sound.
Local highlights include Saquatucket Marina, The Port Restaurant & Bar with its oyster specials, and the Cape Cod Lavender Farm.
